convert_wav2vec2_checkpoint: convert a fairseq wav2vec2 checkpoint to a Hugging Face PyTorch model
convert_wav2vec2_finetuned: convert a fine-tuned fairseq wav2vec2 checkpoint to Hugging Face Wav2Vec2ForCTC with tokenizer and processor
convert_wav2vec2_pretraining: convert an unfinetuned fairseq wav2vec2 checkpoint to Hugging Face Wav2Vec2ForPreTraining
convert_wav2vec2_sequence_classification: convert a fairseq wav2vec2 sequence classification checkpoint to Hugging Face Wav2Vec2ForSequenceClassification
read_txt_into_dict: read a text file into a dictionary mapping line numbers to word values
